name: claude-kit
description: Ticket-to-merge workflow for Claude Code: architecture discussion, worktree setup, TDD, automated PR review, and the design vocabulary that keeps behavior on the right object.

plugins.name: ticket-workflow
plugins.description: End-to-end GitHub ticket workflow. /architect runs the design conversation and files lean issues; /start-ticket sets up an isolated worktree and picks up the plan; /ship-ticket drives TDD through PR, automated review, and cleanup. Includes a PostToolUse hook that posts a Claude review on every PR you open.
